title: Support agent skill
story: In a support tab, I can ask which agent is working on a ticket and who holds it. When I want to correct something I told another agent, the support agent shows me the exact message and the tab it goes to; after I press Send, the message appears in that tab marked 'from Support, for' me. A message can never end with something like 'done' that would press a button in the other agent.
no_qa_reason: The support agent has no screen until issue #96 (support agent tab) lands, and nothing reads a relay request before then; live model behaviour is the demo story's job.
